first_comment: Source: La Tribune de l'Hôtellerie, 18 Oct 2026 — https://latribunedelhotellerie.com/palaces-france-2026-liste-33-hotels-six-nouveaux/
post_text:
France now counts 33 Palace hotels, including six new names in 2026.

The newcomers:

– Bvlgari Hotel Paris
– @Cheval Blanc Paris
– Fouquet's Paris
– Four Seasons Resort Megève
– Hôtel Martinez, Cannes
– Royal Champagne Hôtel & Spa, Champillon

The State grants the distinction for three years, after an assessment led by @Atout France, the agency headed by @Adam Oubuih. Twenty-seven hotels kept their title.

Paris alone holds 13 Palaces. With the Riviera and the Alps, it accounts for 29 of the 33.

The signal: the title is spreading beyond Paris and Courchevel, to Champagne and the Croisette. It remains the clearest marker of the top tier in France.

Which hotel do you see joining the list next?
